status: Exploratory plan recorded before the full census script was executed; not preregistered
prior_inspection: Read-only exploration already inspected aggregate role overlaps and approval/head-SHA diagnostics, including 2026 Q2 and Q3. Analysis choices therefore follow observation of the data.
question: How do author, submitted-reviewer and integrator accounts overlap on the identical merged-PR population, and how much does collected-revision linkage limit interpretation of observed approval records?
population: All human-account-authored PRs merged by the pinned PR-list collection cutoff, with membership identical to the completed review census and merger metadata census
eligibility: Reuse completed review-census exclusions and observed open intervals; include submitted attributed non-bot, non-author reviews no later than the collected cutoff and eventual merge. Reopened PRs can contribute reviews from any observed open interval before merge, not closed intervals.
unknown_actors: Count submitted records without an attributable login only after applying the same temporal/open-interval boundaries; do not classify their human status or allocate an account. Observed account categories and union counts may change if missing identities become known.
secondary_diagnostics: Count eligible records labelled APPROVED in the collected snapshot, and their exact commit_id matches to the collected detail.head.sha. These are nested observed-record diagnostics, not historical approval enforcement, approval validity at merge, or proof that unmatched revisions were unreviewed.
coverage_and_integrity: Require complete checksummed list/detail/review/timeline pages; validate all merged-PR membership, author, integrator, reviewers and merge-quarter fields against existing census outputs; record complete input-page, coverage-file, script/helper, plan and dependency-lock hashes.
interpretation_limits: Accounts are not independently verified people, effort, knowledge holders or bus-factor estimates.
Submitted-review participation does not establish review quality or policy enforcement.
Collected approval states can differ from historical states and may coexist with later review decisions.
Collected head SHA is not independently established as the historical merge-time revision.
Failure to match a review commit to collected head SHA does not establish unreviewed changes or a bypass.
Deleted reviews, informal review, account aliases and non-atomic collection remain outside the audit.
No human responsibility/outcome labels, repair prevalence, causal claim or novelty/acceptance claim follow from this analysis.
